text:
maria: Quick async standup for gateway/routing/auth/rate-limits.
What I did: rolled the new route-weight map to canary (10%), tightened TTL on policy cache, ran smoke tests.
Blockers: seeing recurring 429 bursts from a small set of clients in eu-west; suspect token reuse + burst smoothing misconfig.
Today: dig into rate-limiter logs, open PR for jwt rotation auto-refresh, coordinate with infra for short-term burst bump. @liam @sophia

infra-bot: deploy/canary/gateway-config v2.3.1 -> canary finished: all checks passed :white_check_mark: (duration 08:23)

liam: saw the 429 spike at 03:12 UTC, looks like a client floods with parallel replays. I pulled partial logs, will trace the JWT header chain.
Any chance the client SDK is retrying on 401/429 without backoff?

maria: yep logs show retry bursts. snippet: ```
{"ts":"2026-03-17T03:12:01Z","client_id":"svc-5602","status":429,"route":"/v1/generate","retries":8}
```
Thinking: add short-term smoothing (per-client leaky bucket) + devx outreach to the client.

sophia: pushed a small routing-policy fix to staging that normalizes fallback weights (was 0.0 in one rule). E2E passed. Will merge after @alex reviews. This should reduce backend fanout for failures.

alex: will review the PR in ~30m, if nothing odd I'll merge. also +1 on a quick client throttling rule.

liam: I'll start a quick audit of token refresh codepaths, put findings in the thread. If we need a hotfix for sdk retry logic, we should schedule it asap.

maria: added short issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGPLAT-827 (summary: client burst 429 mitigation). Assigned to @liam, priority P2.

devx-bot: Runbook template for "client burst 429" created: https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/client-burst-429 (fields: detection, mitigation, rollback, contact).

liam: quick note — can we add a small metric for per-client 429-rate in the dashboard? even counts per minute. That would help triage.

sophia: yes, I can add a panel to the gateway dashboard. pairing with @liam tomorrow morning to wire the alert thresholds.

maria: Plan for today summary: 1) triage logs + add dashboard panel (sophia/liam) 2) PR for jwt rotation (maria) 3) small smoothing rule for canary (maria/alex) 4) update runbook and notify affected client via devx.

alex: :thumbsup: ping me on the PR when ready, I'll merge and bump canary to 30% if metrics look stable.

maria: thanks team — will post updates here. no other blockers for me. :coffee:
